requirements.text: A user-friendly online system for students to check the real-time availability of items in the library.
An online process for borrowing and returning items to minimize wait times, while allowing for in-person resolution of issues.
An online reservation system for study rooms, with the ability to address any booking issues in person.
An online renewal process for borrowed items, along with automated fine calculations, while enabling staff to handle exceptions and communicate with students personally regarding fines.
